items.claim: 2025 調整後 EBITA 有機成長目標 10%–15%
items.quote: we have set up a target with an improvement of our adjusted EBITA from 10% to 15% organically.
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 2025 有機營收成長目標 7%–10%
items.quote: strong growth organically between 7% and 10% for the year 2025
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 2025 調整後 EBITA 利潤率目標約 19.2%–19.5%
items.quote: an adjusted EBITA margin around 19.2% to 19.5%
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 跨循環成長率維持 7%–10%
items.quote: we confirm really this 7% to 10% growth across the cycle
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 2025 匯率預期轉為正貢獻，營收約 +6–7 億歐元
items.quote: plus EUR 600 million to EUR 700 million to our top line
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.quote: our ETR will be in the range of 23% to 25% for 2025
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 2025 現金轉換率預期再度接近 100%，含資本支出增加
items.quote: the cash conversion ratio to again be approaching 100%
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: Discrete 自動化需求回升，預期下半年加速
items.quote: accelerating a bit more in the second part of the year 2025
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 2025 毛利率仍有進步但幅度較小
items.quote: some gross margin progression, but at a more muted level
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: Systems 定價在 2025 預期趨於正常化
items.quote: We would expect some normalization of that in 2025.
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 2025 毛利率放緩原因：Systems 定價正常化，加上正常範圍的產業生產力
items.quote: more normal pricing in Systems
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 2024 工業自動化調整後 EBITA 利潤率下滑 150bp，管理層稱符合預期
items.quote: was down, as expected, 150 basis points
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 管理層稱 AI 訓練／推論資料中心對利潤率無特別影響
items.quote: From a margin standpoint, it does not have any particular impact.
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 數字口徑：資料中心占訂單 24% 的拆解
items.quote: Around 20% of that is pure Data Center, around 4% is Distributed IT now.
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 純資料中心中，超大規模雲端客戶占比不到一半
items.quote: Of that 20%, a bit less than half of that will be with hyperscalers.
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 資料中心占 2024 終端訂單 24%
items.quote: that represents 24% of our end orders in 2024
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 資料中心成長描述為健康而非指數式
items.quote: As we've said before, not exponential, but healthy growth
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 針對 DeepSeek 提問，稱客戶端訂單趨勢沒有變化
items.quote: there is no change in the trend
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 北美占比：在地製造在地銷售比例
items.quote: we have already 83% of what we sell in North America
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: DeepSeek 被詮釋為 AI 消耗量增加的佐證
items.quote: the consumption for AI will get bigger and bigger
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 數位與數位賦能營收占比及軟體循環收入占比
items.quote: we're now at 77% recurring revenues in agnostic software
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: Systems 業務 Q4 銷售成長 27%
items.quote: translating into sales of plus 27%
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 北美住宅市場疲弱，管理層歸因於高利率
items.quote: We did see some weakness in residential, particularly in the U.S.
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 法國競爭主管機關罰款已提列 1.04 億歐元準備
items.quote: a provision of EUR 104 million tied to the fine
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 關稅：若現行貿易協定特殊區維持，墨西哥對美進口曝險規模
items.quote: only in a few hundred millions
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 中國 2025 預期無重大轉變
items.quote: we don't expect any major shift in 2025
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 不排除特別配息
items.quote: not averse to some sort of special distribution
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 庫藏股僅用於抵銷員工持股計畫
items.quote: share buybacks to neutralize our employee share plans
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 2027 計畫不含併購
items.quote: the plan that we have presented by '27 is without M&A
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 第 15 年累進股息提案
items.quote: dividend for the 15th year of EUR 3.90 per share
items.speaker: Hilary Maxson (CFO)

items.claim: 下一循環增量產能投資 20 億歐元
items.quote: EUR 2 billion of incremental capacity in the next cycle
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 稱商業應變措施可使 2025 獲利指引仍能達成
items.quote: we will be able still to deliver our profitability guidance in 2025
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: 數位飛輪目標：2027 年占集團營收 60%–65%
items.quote: 60% to 65% of our group revenue by 2027
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

items.claim: Motivair 收購將於數日內完成
items.quote: we are closing, in the coming days, the acquisition of Motivair
items.speaker: Olivier Blum (CEO)

qa_flags.question: James Moore (Redburn)：資料中心各細分（含超大規模雲端）訂單成長幅度與未來 3–5 年展望
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 表示不提供具體數字（'We don't communicate any specific number moving forward'），CFO 給占比拆解但稱難以回推訂單成長率，未確認分析師推算的 70–75% 成長

qa_flags.question: Andre Kukhnin (UBS)：中壓業務占比、急單定價是否已享受、SF6-free 帶來的增量
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 稱不公布占比，轉談 AirSeT 產品更新；未回答急單定價問題與 2025 SF6-free 貢獻；CFO 稱 'you said it all'

qa_flags.question: Alexander Virgo (BofA)：Systems 定價約 15% 以上、2025 毛利率緩和幅度是否如此
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先談產品組合與在地定價能力，CFO 稱無特別事項，只說 Systems 定價預期正常化，未給幅度數字
